body:
### Summary

Per #21347 - we've recently moved to using an Azure Artifacts feed, and are seeing that during resolution uv downloads entire wheels.   The feed does not support PEP658 but it does support range requests, and uv ought to be able to use them.

However, that pull request looks like it may be too simplistic - there's a whole lot of history that I didn't know about!  - so raising this issue to track the bug whether or not that particular proposed fix survives.

I believe that the testcase in that pull request accurately represents the behaviour that we see, but I expect we can get logs if needed

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04

### Version

0.12.7

### Python version

3.14
title: uv resorts to downloading full wheels even though range requests work
